channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 49 new entries
item.description: PASTA in Nature Methods leads the week — a validated tyramide-based method for high-plex simultaneous protein+RNA detection in FFPE is a rare true multi-omics assay in a top journal. LLM-agent pipelines (LungChat, ACCREDIT, ASTA) were a notable sub-theme. Also worth noting: several MS-imaging advances pushed spatial lipidomics/metabolomics resolution.
